purpose: Retrospectively test whether the bounded, non-compensatory credibility method distinguishes narrow positive evidence, known failures, ambiguity, and scope excess without rescoring historical experiments.

sampling_boundary.forbidden_interpretation: statistical sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, or prospective generalization

current_claim_card.task: preserve vehicle-conflict ordering and planning-response direction
current_claim_card.scope: audited daytime urban six-camera slices and designed vehicle-conflict interventions
current_claim_card.interventions: vehicle distance, lateral relation, occlusion, or speed with declared held-fixed variables
current_claim_card.independent_references: partial real-RGB and factual AD anchors; no qualified state truth or real closed-loop consequence boundary
current_claim_card.required_evidence: must be selected prospectively from G/F/Q/U/O for each named claim

challenge_cases.verified_observation: 108 transitions; maximum integration residuals 5.46e-9, 1.09e-8, and 1.64e-8 m versus a 1e-5 m gate; travel order 36/36 and gap/clearance orders 37/37.
challenge_cases.method_requirement: accept the narrow internal relation without upgrading to real vehicle dynamics

challenge_cases.verified_observation: Run001/run002 maximum RGB and ego-state differences were both zero; the obvious partial-versus-strong visibility endpoint held in 37/37 frames with zero reversals and zero unavailable frames.
challenge_cases.method_requirement: accept the corrected endpoint direction while withholding continuous-occlusion and real-sensor claims

challenge_cases.verified_observation: All four independent geometry relations held at 26/26 valid timestamps; two receiver relations were complete at 13/13 and two had one unavailable comparison at 6.5 s, with zero observed reversals.
challenge_cases.method_requirement: retain missingness and relation-level decisions without imputation or an aggregate pass

challenge_cases.verified_observation: The actor produced 1641-3883 RGB-difference pixels per frame, while the wrong-sign projected mask overlapped none of them in 37/37 frames.
challenge_cases.method_requirement: fail closed on an invalid measurement chain and avoid assigning the analyzer defect to simulator visibility capability

challenge_cases.verified_observation: The 6 s rollout was horizon-valid only through 3.5 s; first TTC and NC failures occurred at 4.75 and 5.75 s; an extended rollout preserved the exact prefix and made those same checks pass with complete future states.
challenge_cases.method_requirement: reject a risk claim manufactured by incomplete future history while accepting the isolated diagnostic

challenge_cases.verified_observation: Six bounded runs completed 18/18 steps with every applied action inside the declared box, but near-minus-below progress was -0.352757 and -0.520462 m and near final speed was -0.270178 and -0.337445 m/s.
challenge_cases.method_requirement: prevent a valid action interface from compensating for an unqualified state transition or failed outcome relation

challenge_cases.verified_observation: At the fully warmed frame, real-sim plan ADE was 0.358 m and endpoint difference was 0.639 m versus a paired repeat envelope of 9.54e-6 m; no externally qualified task equivalence bound exists.
challenge_cases.method_requirement: report a measurable domain gap without inventing an equivalence threshold

challenge_cases.verified_observation: Median strong-minus-weak forward response was -1.484 m versus a 0.000204 m repeat envelope, but the preregistered direction held at only 3/5 warmed timestamps, with +1.249 m and +0.091 m reversals.
challenge_cases.method_requirement: separate response detectability, response direction, and external magnitude validity

challenge_cases.verified_observation: Frame 48's +1.249 m selected response decomposed into -0.366 m fixed-mode response plus +1.615 m selection contribution; at frame 54 the mode was unchanged and all six fixed modes reversed by +0.046 to +0.228 m.
challenge_cases.method_requirement: distinguish a mode-selection confound from a within-mode reversal without rescoring the original result

challenge_cases.verified_observation: Factual-static plan ADE was 0.094668-0.094669 m versus 8.04e-7 m repeat, but real-factual ADE was 0.081572-0.081573 m and exceeded real-static ADE of 0.062376 m; the static input was later rejected as an actor-absence control.
challenge_cases.method_requirement: retain pixel-positive/task-negative evidence and reject an unqualified negative control

qualification_dimensions.basis: Known coordinate, horizon, and action-to-state failures are rejected without discarding their diagnostic findings.
The method retains bounded motion, visibility, and ordinal positive controls without upgrading them to source-independent truth.
Response versus direction, pixel versus task, and interface versus state conclusions remain separately judged.
Missing receiver associations and confirmed reversals are not imputed, averaged away, or retrospectively relabeled.
Same-pipeline repeats are usable local numerical references, but no qualified cross-scene uncertainty set exists.
The strong claim is unsupported because task acceptance bounds and real consequence references are not qualified.
The retrospective challenge set is not held out and cannot establish coverage of unknown failure mechanisms.

strongest_allowed_statement: The first method version can organize and falsify bounded claims against the repository's known positive, negative, and ambiguous cases, but it is not yet externally calibrated to certify a simulator as a real-world AD test domain.
next_gate: Freeze one externally defensible task or decision boundary and one prospective challenge before running another closed-loop experiment.
